newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB SETS A$600 MLN CP FOR WESTFIELD TRUST.
newsitem.headline: NAB SETS A$600 MLN CP FOR WESTFIELD TRUST.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd, as lead manager and arranger, said on Tuesday it had launched a A$600 million commercial paper programme for property group Westfield Trust.
In a statement NAB, said the issue was the first domestic capital markets issue for Westfield Trust, a major shopping centre owner.
Dealers for the programme are NAB, Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd, Bankers Trust Australia Ltd, Commonwealth Bank of Australia and Westpac Banking Corporation.
